headline: S&P 500 Nears Record on Tech Leadership
detail: The market is pushing towards new highs, with tech names leading the charge. This generally supports your QQQ and SPY holdings, but your concentrated tech/chip book will be sensitive to any shifts in this leadership.

detail: This news highlights growth in the digital currency space, potentially benefiting companies like COIN if it signals increased adoption or institutional interest. COIN is currently a "WATCH" on your scanner.

headline: Treasury Yields Slip Below 5%
detail: Lower Treasury yields can sometimes make growth stocks, like those in your tech portfolio, more attractive by reducing the discount rate on future earnings. This is a supportive backdrop for your holdings.
rec: No action warranted by this headline alone.
